senses.gloss: m. (reduplic. of קא; cmp. קָאַת) name of a bird, pelican.
units: Ḥull. 63ᵃ קאת זה הק׳ Ms. M. (ed. הקוק, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note), the Biblical ḳaath is the modern ḳiḳ, v. קָאַת; Yalk. Lev. 537 הקוק; Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4ᶜ.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:1:10">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <he>שמן קיק</he> Mish.
ib. II, 1) עוף הוא ושמו ק׳ it is a bird whose name is ḳiḳ. [For other opinions on the meaning of שמן ק׳, v. קָאוָא, קִיסוֹסָא, קִיקָיוֹן.]
